required_independent_authorities.native_tuple_fit: Actual native fit receipt for exact definition/version/seed/size/difficulty and Campaign source/layout/binding identities, including army/facility/route legality; development three-size seed1 or edit-mode readback is not exact tuple fit.
required_independent_authorities.run_grant: Fresh finite host/epoch/owned-job authorization plus source-fit and exclusive dispatch partition; existing Mac worker remains disabled until separately reviewed.

selected card and normal input contact receipts -> actual queued payload -> owned world/session
launch-definition record -> actual source resolver -> actual loaded Campaign geometry and logical placements
actual compiled setup hash/content identity -> native v1 identity -> run CSV/trace/config/source/build hashes
same reviewed dispatch/fit identity through save, source reload and resume; no index-only or practice fallback
finished frozen outcome -> normal rendered result and Main Menu -> profile before/restore/after and ownership cleanup
camera journal remains pending until actual required native boundaries exist; no invented events
must_remain_zero: unreviewed private QA availability or boolean eligibility flags
